title: Jim Keller argues the Moon-landing videos were faked
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jim Keller argues the Moon-landing videos were faked, about 1969 at San Francisco Bay Area, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Jim Keller took part in a debate over whether the videos of the 1969 Moon landing were faked. According to Michels, Keller argued the side that the videos were fake, which, if true, would mean the famous footage was not what it seems.
